video_title: ¿Cómo se dice la RUTINA DIARIA en inglés? ⏰
video_description: Tu día entero en diez verbos, de despertarte a dormirte. 🌙
title: ¿Cómo se dice…?
intro: [cheerful] Diez palabras. Piensa antes de que yo lo diga.
recap: Otra vez, todas seguidas: wake up, get up, get dressed, have breakfast, go to work, have lunch, go home, have dinner, go to bed, fall asleep.
full_script: [cheerful] Diez palabras. Piensa antes de que yo lo diga. Despertarse... wake up. wake up. Levantarse... get up. get up. Vestirse... get dressed. get dressed. Desayunar... have breakfast. have breakfast. Ir a trabajar... go to work. go to work. Almorzar... have lunch. have lunch. Volver a casa... go home. go home. Cenar... have dinner. have dinner. Acostarse... go to bed. go to bed. Dormirse... fall asleep. fall asleep. Otra vez, todas seguidas: wake up, get up, get dressed, have breakfast, go to work, have lunch, go home, have dinner, go to bed, fall asleep. [curious] ¿Cuál no sabías? Cuéntamelo abajo.
